latest_news: NOTICE: Candidates are advised to refer to the Notice dated 16.09.2026 regarding the Guidelines on Assessment of Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) for Admission to Postgraduate Medical Courses, 2026. For any queries or issues related to the said guidelines, kindly contact the National Medical Commission (NMC).
The Primary Assessment Board will be available until 15.10.2026, and the Appellate Board will be available until 18.10.2026.
